title: Edit: fillet the top edges
prompt: Add a 2 mm fillet feature to the top outside edges of the block (not the pocket).

hidden_tests.description: Evaluates cleanly and every body is a valid closed solid
Four top outside edges rounded R2
Four cylindrical faces (the pocket stays square)
The fillet rounds the top edges, not the bottom ones: the centroid sits at z = 9.2443 (9.3213 if the bottom were rounded)
One feature added, nothing else changed

notes: The fillet runs around the top rim (four straight edges meeting at sharp vertical corners): (1 − π/4)·r²·(2·60 + 2·40 − corner overlaps). Construction: fillet reads the fillet features the prompt asks for (no geometry equivalent in the report), so a correct part built otherwise fails only that test.
